arjun: Dropping the authn/authz postmortem link: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2468135790. We need a tight closure list: specific owners, short ETAs, and a weekly drift scan that detects TTL divergence and missing audit Authenticate events. Claim items and add a 1-line verification for the runbook.

mei: I'll take audit ingestion gaps and DLQ for malformed payloads. Plan: small staging replay (36h window), add schema validator that routes to DLQ + alert. Backfill ETA: 2026-03-29. Validator PR ETA: 2026-04-02. Smoke: `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM audit WHERE protoPayload.methodName=\"Authenticate\" AND timestamp > TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 36 HOUR)`

carl: I'll own token validation fixes (TTL unification + eliminate refresh race). Adding a CI guard that fails builds if TTL difference >8s. ETA: 2026-04-01. Smoke: `pytest tests/unit/test_token_ttl.py::test_ttl_unified -q`

tori: I'll handle RBAC cleanup for emergency grants and add a nightly CI lint that flags cluster-admin-like binds in svc-* namespaces. ETA: 2026-04-07. Smoke: `kubectl get clusterrolebinding -o json | jq '.items[] | select(.subjects[]?.name|test("svc-")) | {name:.metadata.name,role:.roleRef.name}' | grep -v limited-access`

arjun: Secrets rotation for affected service accounts needs an owner and infra assistance for HSM import. Who can pick it up?

mei: I can coordinate the secrets rotation canary in staging and update the runbook with HSM steps, but will need infra for the import. Staging rotate ETA: 2026-03-31, prod rotate ETA: 2026-04-03. Runbook smoke: `kubectl get secret sa-key -n default -o jsonpath='{.metadata.annotations.createdAt}'`

sec-bot: Created ticket SEC-1427: "AuthN/AuthZ closure + remediation ownership". Claimed items: audit-dlq (mei), token-unify (carl), rbac-cleanup (tori), secrets-rotation (mei+infra). Added recurrence: weekly drift check (cron: 0 09 * * 1). Link: https://tracker.redwood/SEC-1427

arjun: Putting the consolidated checklist here. Update SEC-1427 as you make progress. We'll review in the next security sync; escalate to #eng-oncall if blocked.

- [ ] Audit replay (36h) + schema validator -> DLQ  owner: mei  due: 2026-03-29 / validator PR 2026-04-02
- [ ] Token TTL unification + CI guard (fail on >8s drift)  owner: carl  due: 2026-04-01
- [ ] RBAC cleanup + nightly lint to block broad binds  owner: tori  due: 2026-04-07
- [ ] Secrets rotation canary + runbook HSM notes  owner: mei + infra  due: 2026-03-31 (staging) / 2026-04-03 (prod)
- [ ] Weekly drift monitor (alert on TTL divergence >8s and missing Authenticate events)  owner: sec-bot (SRE)  recurring weekly

carl: ACK. I'll open TTL PR and include the small CI script snippet in the description.

mei: Starting staging replay tonight in a small window; will escalate in SEC-1427 if malformed rate >4%.

tori: Inventorying wide binds now and will post a minimal RBAC patch + lint job.

arjun: Quick note: we saw this pattern recur around timezone rollovers and large rollouts. Ops, make sure weekly scan tolerates daylight savings flips and clock skew.

sec-bot: Scheduled SEC-1427-review: 2026-04-09 15:00 UTC. Reminder 24h prior. :calendar:"
